description: Maps JsonForm definitions (formId) + fieldId to a Commerce.Api lookup type whose values populate that select. optionValueKey: form submits id or code; primary category must use id to match categories.id / product_categories FK.

bindings.label: Product type
bindings.description: From Commerce.Api lookup `product_types` (value id is stored on the product as product_type_id).

bindings.label: Primary category
bindings.description: Mirrored from Commerce.Api catalog categories into lookup type product_categories (ids align with categories.id). Each value’s parent_value_id should reference product_types so the vendor Product form filters categories when a product type is selected.
